title: The Sync Post With Other Site WordPress plugin before 1.9.4 does not properly authorize a content-management action…
description: The Sync Post With Other Site WordPress plugin versions prior to 1.9.4 have an authorization flaw that allows users with Contributor-level access or higher to create and modify arbitrary custom post types, including changing content authorship. This issue affects post types other than pages and can lead to unauthorized content management actions.
